items.title: Germany's far-right AfD set for big win in eastern state, just short of majority
items.description: Germany's AfD has hailed a "historic result" and is projected to win 44% of the vote, far ahead of the conservatives on 17%.

items.title: Zelensky says he expects war to continue into winter after talks with US envoys
items.description: There was no announcement of a major breakthrough, after Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner travelled to Kyiv.

items.title: Peace talks rich in symbolism but fundamental differences between Russia and Ukraine remain
items.description: Despite talks between US envoys and both Putin and Zelensky, the expectation in Kyiv is the fighting will continue, writes James Landale.

items.title: Volcano eruption leaves 170,000 passengers stranded in Indonesia
items.description: More than 170,000 airline passengers are stranded after ash was detected in airspace near Jakarta following the eruptions.

items.title: Dozens feared trapped in collapsed building in Delhi
items.description: As many as 50 people are thought to have been inside the five-storey hostel when it came down.

items.title: TV presenter among 12 sentenced to death in Egypt drugs case
items.description: Sarah Khalifa is best known for her TV programme Mission Impossible which dealt with crime issues.

items.title: Iran warns of 'faster, heavier, more painful response' to US attacks
items.description: The comments came a day after Washington said it had struck Iranian oil tankers in response to Tehran's attacks on US warships in the region.

items.title: Prince William to attend King Harald's funeral in Norway
items.description: The Prince of Wales will represent the King at the funeral of Harald V in Oslo next week.

items.title: Mistrial declared in Lindsay Clancy murder case, after jury deadlocks
items.description: The mistrial now puts the murder case - and Clancy's future - in limbo as to whether she will be held criminally liable in the deaths of her three kids.

items.title: Trump signs order to remove endangered species protection for grey wolves
items.description: The US president says the move will help ranchers, but conservationists say it could derail efforts to recover populations.

items.title: At least two dead in blast at Bolivia military barracks
items.description: Authorities fear the death toll in Viacha will rise and warn people to stay away from the barracks due to a risk of further explosions.

items.title: Europe targeted by spiralling campaign of sabotage - and Russia is the chief suspect
items.description: Germany has blamed Russia for an attack on Leipzig airport but there has been a series of suspicious incidents elsewhere.

items.title: Nepal rescuers try to reach dozens trapped in tunnel after two found alive
items.description: More than 1,300 people have died and thousands are missing, but rescuers' hopes have risen after finding survivors in a tunnel.

items.title: Germany's far-right AfD bids for first taste of power in eastern vote
items.description: If it wins an outright majority in Saxony-Anhalt, it would be the first time a far-right party has held state-level power in Germany since World War Two.

items.title: UN votes to adopt new world map to reflect Africa's true size
items.description: The Togo-sponsored resolution was backed by 164 nations - with the US as the only nation to vote against it.

items.title: Russia hits Ukrainian security headquarters in drone attack, Zelensky says
items.description: The unmanned aerial vehicle struck without warning in the heart of the Ukrainian capital.

items.title: Tate brothers officially indicted with trafficking and sex crimes in Romania
items.description: Andrew and Tristan Tate are currently in a Miami jail fighting extradition to the UK over separate charges and deny all the allegations.

items.title: 'He was a lifeline' - Families at a loss after Haitian caregivers let go in US
items.description: Haitian immigrants make up a large portion of the already overburdened home-care workforce.

items.title: Majority Russian-speaking city in Ukraine considers language ban in the arts
items.description: Ukraine's third-biggest city Odesa decides this week whether to ban Russian-language content in music and literature in public.

items.title: Aviation faces hotter, stormier skies – and passengers might have to accept more disruption
items.description: Are people going to have to increasingly accept more delays and diversions as the effects of climate change intensify?
